rejected_findings.title: draw_end commits a stale snap target; surface releases are never re-snapped (limb-crossing commit)
rejected_findings.reject_reason: Mechanism unreachable: any pointer travel fires motion events, and draw_move re-snaps on every on-surface motion (null far from nodes); a sky release nulls the snap; a release without travel sits at the last motion's point, where snap state is consistent. The claimed 'release far from every node commits' path requires a discontinuous pointer teleport between last motion and release — not a real desktop input sequence. Evidence lines are real but the claimed behavior does not hold; the underlying asymmetry survives as carry-forward note r1#2.
